verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe built-in message search with a wide array of filters that combine with keywords. A channel filter is shown (channel:design has:image), and channels:public searches across all public channels, which covers the channel and breadth parts of the story. A 2018 community comment says search 'barely works', but it is vague and not a concrete counter-example, so it only lowers confidence. Missing for 10: documented sender filter, documented date-range filter, explicit full-history (including private) search for admins, independent hands-on corroboration.
